Subject: homological algebra | ID: 69712

Statement

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every integrable solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Step 1. Consider the Hilbert-Schmidt operator \(R_{01310011}\) acting on the Hardy space. By the Hilbert-Schmidt decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|R_{01310011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01310011\).

Step 3. By the trace-class spectral theorem, we decompose \(B_{01310013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the trace-class spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via linear interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
